title: Why Jermod McCoy's slide has gone from potential top-10 pick to last day of the NFL Draft

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Why Jermod McCoy's slide has gone from potential top-10 pick to last day of the NFL Draft
sources.description: Sources told Yahoo Sports that McCoy's knee also had a repair that included a "bone plug." The concern with the procedure is that over time, it can call for re-operation and the kind of chronic cartilage issues that end athletic careers.
